body:
📦 **Sculpture `57f8dd63`** — Split shipyard static decorative hulls into yard-hull submodels

Refs TASK-1350

Split the decorative hull_frame voxels out of all four shipyards into
independent twin submodels (meta.kind = "yard-hull") so bare slipway
rails, cross-ties, and underwater pilings remain intact and idle
shipyards display empty slipways without decorative static hulls:
- ame-carib-civic-01m-shipyard-small -> *-hull (15,498 voxels)
- ame-carib-civic-01m-shipyard-large -> *-hull (53,946 voxels)
- crest-waterside-01m-shipyard-small-water -> *-hull (17,322 voxels)
- crest-waterside-01m-shipyard-large-water -> *-hull (48,690 voxels)

Second keels on large shipyards remain in -body as intended.

👥 參與者：@ridge-001

---
